name: Vividos
about: Vividos (class 1045), Lothian's Scion and then the Necromancer, keeper of the Tomb of Moriens in the Cemetery. INT-gated topic (PLAN-LEVELING.md 5; game/npc_dialog.h 'avatar_int'): shown only when the Avatar's INT is at least the number, behind New Dialogue. Virtues topic (PLAN-VIRTUES.md 3.11; feature virtues): words for Lothian beside Vividos after the burial (Humility, Spirituality). Honor (2026-11-08): the promise to bring back the ceremonial dagger (mark vividos_promise; the deed vividos_promise_kept pays when it is handed over, G[189:1]).

topics.label: If the dead live on in Lithos' realm, whose voice spoke from the bones?
say: You have a sharp wit, friend. Sharper than is comfortable, perhaps.
The dead do dwell in the City of the Dead, under the Mountain King. And yet their bones answered you. Both are true.
I think of it this way. The bone is a door, and Death Speak knocks upon it. What answers is not the bone, but neither is it far away.
Do not ask me to say more. I would not wish to color your expectations. Lithos keeps His own counsel, and so should His servants.

topics.label: Lothian's rest
say: Lothian is with Lithos now. The tomb is sealed. What more would you have?

topics.label: Let me kneel and say words for Lothian with you, in your way, not mine.
say: An outlander, asking to learn our words. That is not a thing I expected to hear.
Kneel, then. Say after me: from the earth, to the earth, and through the earth to Lithos.
...It is done. The Necromancers will hear of this. They do not forget a kindness, or a slight.
The Avatar of Tenebrae, asking to learn our words. That is not a thing I expected to hear.
Kneel, then. Say after me: from the earth, to the earth, and through the earth to Lithos.
...It is done. The Necromancers will hear of this. They do not forget a kindness, or a slight.

topics.label: Nothing. Farewell.
say: Go in peace, then.

topics.label: About the dagger
say: The dagger. Without it, Lothian cannot pass to Lithos. Do not tell me it is harder than you thought.

topics.label: I give you my word: the dagger will come back to this tomb.
say: Your word. Outlanders give it easily. Let us see whether yours weighs anything.
Your word. Even an Avatar's word must be weighed. Let us see whether yours weighs anything.

topics.label: I will do what I can.
say: That is what they all say.

topics.label: Lothian can rot for all I care.
say: Vividos goes very still.
Speak of the dead that way again in this place, outlander, and you will join them.
Vividos goes very still.
Speak of the dead that way again in this place, Avatar or no, and you will join them.
